message: You know, there's something funny about storms — like how they manage to catch us off guard every single time. Last week, I found myself rummaging through my closet for the old flashlight that, of course, was nowhere to be found. I stumbled upon this handy resource about tornadoes that reminded me it’s not just about finding the flashlight, but also knowing what to do before the storm hits. Getting a little prepared can turn potential chaos into a calm plan of action. What's your storm strategy? 🌩️
